question.text: Correct pair of compounds which gives blue colouration/precipitate and white precipitate, respectively, when their Lassaigne's test is separately done is

solution.text: $\begin{array}{ll}\text {Hydrozine, } & \mathrm{NH}_{2} \cdot \mathrm{NH}_{2} \text { does not respond }\end{array}$ Lassaigne's test because it does not contain any carbon and hence, NaCN is not formed. Compound, $\mathrm{NH}_{2}-\mathrm{CS}-\mathrm{NH}_{2}$ contains both $\mathrm{N}$ and $\mathrm{S}$, hence, it will give red colour in Lassaigne test.
